subject.title: fix: keep tail alive and replay timed-out messages

question: Is the focused automated Gateway/HTTP test matrix sufficient evidence for this message-delivery change, or must the branch show a live Discord timeout-and-replay run before merge?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent and heavily tested, but only a maintainer can accept whether simulated coverage is adequate for a durable message-recovery boundary while the current test check is failing.

options.title: Require focused live validation
options.body: Resolve the failing check and capture redacted logs from a real Discord run showing the tail survives a handler timeout and replay recovers the exact missed message without duplicate events or cursor regression.

options.title: Accept automated coverage
options.body: After resolving the failing check, merge based on the extensive focused test matrix if maintainers consider the simulated Gateway and exact-fetch paths representative enough.

recommendation.title: Require focused live validation
